source_row.extraction_instructions: Listing: /learn/courses is ONE server-rendered page of ~24 .ihi-card cards (no pagination); only cards labelled 'Begins <date>' or 'Last Call <date>' are dated runs (courses live under /learn/courses and /learn/certifications). Flagship events come from schema.org ConferenceEvent JSON-LD on /connect/events (IHI Forum, Lisbon Healthcare Improvement Forum). Detail: JSON-LD Event gives start/end/format; 'Format/Where/Fee/Groups of 3 or more' header gives venue and USD fees; CPD from 'approved to provide N credits'. Skips On-Demand, In-Progress and Interest List cards.

registry_comment: IHI — dated course/certification runs from /learn/courses cards + ConferenceEvent JSON-LD from /connect/events; USD

concerns: Volume is 13, not the ~75 recon estimate: the courses listing has only 24 cards total. Skipped: 1 On-Demand, 2 In-Progress, 10 Interest List (undated). Plus 1 webinar 'Informational Call' (plain Event, Zoom link) skipped on the events page. These skipped counts come from the live page on 2026-10-03 and will change.

'Last Call' course (Better Quality Through Better Measurement) started 2026-09-24 but registration is open until 2026-10-21, so start_date is in the past while end_date (2026-12-17) is future. Kept because it is still bookable; the archival rule should key off end_date.
Interest List courses become dated runs when IHI opens a cohort; they will be picked up automatically once their card label changes to 'Begins ...'.
Lisbon forum (internationalforum.bmj.com) is a BMJ-run site with no parsable fee table: pricing_tiers is empty. IHI Forum early-bird (-$200 until Sep 30) is not modelled, only the standard rates.
Forum fees page contains a stale previous-year block below the current one; parser stops at 'In-Person Registration'. If IHI reorders that page the fee parse may need a look.
Year-long programmes (Improvement Advisor) have end_date up to 2028; region for US cities is set to 'United States' since the site only gives a state abbreviation.
Course card URLs for certification runs contain double-encoded %25 junk from IHI; they resolve (200) so kept verbatim as booking_url/dedupe key.
Cloud access: no bot protection seen; --force-fallback (Playwright path) gave identical 13 shells. with_pricing 12/13 because the Lisbon event has none.
